execution_trace: CLI selects local evaluation source files and compiles them with esbuild.
loadModule constructs and invokes a Function with require/module/filename/dirname context to register evaluation tasks. The constructor is not fed decoded payload content.
percentDecode handles URL percent encoding; decodeBodyToString converts Bedrock response bytes to text. Neither supplies this Function body.
runGitCommand resolves git through absolute PATH entries and invokes execFile with an argument vector.
configureNode reads BRAINTRUST_API_KEY or the nearest .env.braintrust for service authentication. SDK logs and traces are sent to configured Braintrust service connections.

Unchanged postinstall fallback selects a declared per-platform optional CLI package, fetches its versioned npm tarball, extracts the expected member, writes it and chmods it to 0755. bin/bt launches that binary when invoked.

rule_changes.unsupported_claim: The rule required only a require-parameter Function constructor anywhere in the file and two naming categories. run plus exec sufficed with no decoder. It checked neither exports, invocation, shared bodies nor data flow. Braintrust contains both naming populations in independent functions.

rule_changes.unchanged_capabilities: All existing construction, execution, encoding, crypto, networking, file access and permission findings remain exactly unchanged.

The obfuscation ancestor has three consumers: concealed-credential-exfiltration-channel, suspicious-hidden-listener and long-tail-build-config-payload. Neutral naming facts must not supply their required concealment evidence. No applicable ancestor selectors consume the new naming atoms.
